resources.string: Detects when the text \"mj\" is sent in any app and plays a Spider-Man animation over the screen.
If the animation fails to play on some devices, the app remembers software decoding automatically. You can also switch it here.
On MIUI / HyperOS and other non-stock systems, enable auto-start and set the battery policy to \"No restrictions\", otherwise the accessibility service may be killed by the system.

This app uses an accessibility service to watch input events and plays a local Spider-Man animation with sound when "mj" is sent.

• Fully offline: no network access, no data collection
• Does not modify the system or harm your device
• Make sure you downloaded it from the official repository: github.com/woods-marshes/MJ

For learning and exchange purposes only — please delete within 24 hours of downloading. Spider-Man and related characters are trademarks of Marvel / Disney. Animation assets come from the open-source project Tiktok-MJ-for-Wechat.
Type \"mj\" in any app\'s input box and tap send — the Spider-Man animation will play on top of the screen.
